name: Nayti
source:
Nayti possesses a noble character and cares deeply for others. Nayti is meticulous in fulfilling his duties and has a passionate, fiery temperament.

Little is known about Nayti’s past, except that he may have lost hir family during the war against Beexen’s ghosts. By the beginning of The Beexen’s Tale, he is a member of the resistance movement opposing Beexen’s ghosts.
